table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname = item.name,
		doctorname=(select name from doctors  where doctors.doctcode=saleledger.doctcode),
		docttitile=(select title1 from doctors  where doctors.doctcode=saleledger.doctcode),
		doctcode=max(saleledger.doctcode),
		 looseqty = Sum (dbo.saledetail.looseqty),
		 price = Max (dbo.saledetail.saleprice),
		 manufacturer = m.name,
		 category = c.name
FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saledetail,    
		 dbo.item,
		 dbo.manufacturer m, 
		 dbo.itemcategory c
WHERE  CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		 	When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
			When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
			When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
  		 End Between :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
		 dbo.saleledger.doctcode IN (:al_doctcode) AND
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND
		 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode and
		 dbo.item.manfcode = m.manfcode and
		 dbo.item.icatcode = c.icatcode
Group by 
		saleledger.doctcode,
		dbo.saledetail.icode,
		dbo.item.name,
		m.name,
		c.name
UNION ALL
SELECT itemname = item.name,
		 doctorname=(select name from doctors  where doctors.doctcode=saleledger.doctcode),
		docttitile=(select title1 from doctors  where doctors.doctcode=saleledger.doctcode),
		doctcode=max(saleledger.doctcode), 
		looseqty = Sum (sd.looseqty),
		 price = Max (sd.saleprice),
		 manufacturer = m.name,
		 category = c.name
FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saleinvdetail sd,    
		 dbo.item,
		 dbo.manufacturer m,
		 dbo.itemcategory c
WHERE  DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
		 CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
		 	When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate 
			When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.date
			When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
  		 End Between :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
		 
		 dbo.saleledger.doctcode IN (:al_doctcode) AND
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
		 sd.icode = item.icode and
		 dbo.item.manfcode = m.manfcode and
		 dbo.item.icatcode = c.icatcode
Group by 
		saleledger.doctcode,
		sd.icode,
		dbo.item.name,
		m.name,
		c.name
ORDER BY
		doctorname,
		item.name
